sections.h2: A composite cylinder of comparable size weighs about a third of steel

chart.title: Composite construction cuts the empty weight of a comparable cylinder by about two-thirds
chart.source: Standard steel cylinder weight as cited in the post; Time Technoplast LiteSafe specification table.

sections.means: Composite cylinders are lighter, rust-free and translucent, which makes them easier to handle and to check for remaining gas.
sections.todo: Scale composite cylinder output from domestic HDPE, since feedstock cost is what keeps them in limited circulation.

sections.means: The same refiner that sells the HDPE-bodied Xtralite is also investing in the capacity that could supply it.
sections.todo: Track whether the reported 200 KTA project is commissioned, since it would add to the HDPE supply a composite cylinder needs.

sections.h2: Industrial LPG is squeezed while household cylinder deliveries stay large

chart.title: Bulk LPG fell 83.1% in May 2026, far more than national consumption at 20.5%

sections.means: A 70% cap on commercial and industrial LPG demand protects household supply while bulk supply is restricted.
sections.todo: Watch the household channel while the cap is in place, since it is the supply the composite cylinder would serve.
